Department

Comprehensive Medical Department

Advanced care in various medical fields provided by industry-leading experts.

Nephrology

Kidney diseases are rising rapidly across India and particularly in urban regions like Kolkata, largely due to diabetes, hypertension, lifestyle changes, and lack of early detection. Many kidney conditions progress silently and are often diagnosed only when significant damage has already occurred. This makes timely consultation with a nephrology specialist essential.At Nephrocare India, we provide comprehensive and evidence-based kidney care through our dedicated Nephrology Department in Kolkata. Our focus is on early diagnosis, prevention of disease progression, and structured long-term management. Patients seeking the best nephrology treatment in Kolkata benefit from a patient-centric, ethical, and guideline-driven approach to kidney health.

View Details

Healthcare Solutions

Our Services

Explore our wide range of specialized medical services tailored to your needs.

Dialysis Service

Our Dialysis Services provide advanced, safe, and compassionate care for patients with kidney failure. With modern equipment and experienced nephrology specialists, we ensure effective dialysis treatment in a comfortable and closely monitored environment to support better health and quality of life.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

IgA Nephropathy Care

gA Nephropathy Care provides specialized, long-term management for patients with IgA-related kidney disease. Our approach focuses on accurate diagnosis, strict blood pressure control, reduction of urine protein, immune modulation when required, and continuous monitoring to preserve kidney function and delay progression to chronic kidney failure.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

Lupus Nephropathy Management

Lupus Nephropathy Management provides comprehensive, stage-wise care for kidney involvement in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Our approach focuses on early diagnosis, immune control, reduction of proteinuria, prevention of flares, and long-term protection of kidney function through evidence-based treatment and continuous nephrology supervision.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

Genetic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) Management

Genetic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) Management offers comprehensive, long-term care for patients with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease. Our approach focuses on early diagnosis, monitoring cyst progression, controlling blood pressure, managing complications, and protecting kidney function to delay kidney failure and improve quality of life.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

Glomerulonephritis Treatment

Glomerulonephritis Treatment offers expert evaluation and stage-wise management of kidney diseases caused by inflammation of the glomeruli. Our approach focuses on identifying the underlying cause, controlling immune activity, reducing proteinuria, and protecting kidney function through targeted medications, close monitoring, and long-term nephrology care.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

Hypertensive Nephropathy Care

Hypertensive Nephropathy Care provides comprehensive treatment for kidney damage caused by long-standing or poorly controlled high blood pressure. Our approach focuses on strict blood pressure control, kidney-protective medications, lifestyle modification, and continuous monitoring to slow disease progression and reduce the risk of dialysis.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

Conservative Kidney Care

Conservative Kidney Care is a comprehensive, patient-centered approach for individuals with chronic kidney disease who are not on dialysis or wish to delay it. This care focuses on preserving remaining kidney function, managing symptoms, controlling complications, and improving overall quality of life through medications, diet, lifestyle changes, and continuous medical supervision.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Management

Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a long-term condition in which kidney function gradually declines over months or years. In many patients, CKD progresses silently and is often detected only after significant kidney damage has already occurred. Early diagnosis, correct staging, and structured medical management are critical to slowing disease progression and preventing complications.

Patients Treated24/7
Learn More

OUR WELLNESS & REHABILITATION FACILITIES

Lifestyle, Mukti and Wellness Program

Personalized wellness and rehabilitation support designed to improve physical, mental, and lifestyle health. Each patient is carefully assessed and provided with a customized yoga, nutrition, and lifestyle plan guided by trained professionals.

Personalized Yoga & Mukti Wellness Program

One-on-one yoga sessions prescribed after patient assessment with expert guidance and regular follow-up. Flexible online and offline classes are available through our Mukti wellness program.

Rehabilitation & Physical Wellness Support

Structured rehabilitation programs to improve mobility, strength, and recovery for individuals managing chronic conditions and long-term health challenges.

Nutrition & Lifestyle Management

Comprehensive support including nutritional guidance, weight management, body composition analysis, anthropometry, and lifestyle education for sustainable wellness.
